title: Discussing housing news politely
objectives: Describe how the issue affects you
Acknowledge another view and offer your own concern
Ask an open question that keeps the discussion constructive

courseTemplate.setting: The conversation is about fictional local housing reports. One speaker's rent rose eight percent. Use tentative language about opinions.

roles.learner: A colleague discussing a housing story
roles.partner: A coworker with a different view on housing

courseTemplate.openingLine: Did you see the news about housing prices going up again?

targetPatterns.pattern: Yes. My rent just went up eight percent, so it's been on my mind.
targetPatterns.example: Yes. My rent just went up eight percent, so it's been on my mind.

targetPatterns.pattern: I see your point. I'm also worried about what renters can afford right now.
targetPatterns.example: I see your point. I'm also worried about what renters can afford right now.

targetPatterns.pattern: What short-term changes do you think might help?
targetPatterns.example: What short-term changes do you think might help?

targetPatterns.pattern: Did you follow the news about the election?
targetPatterns.example: Did you follow the news about the election?
targetPatterns.translation: 你关注选举的新闻了吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: I read a different angle on that story.
targetPatterns.example: I read a different angle on that story.
targetPatterns.translation: 我看到这个故事的不同角度报道。

targetPatterns.pattern: I'd rather not get into politics, if that's OK.
targetPatterns.example: I'd rather not get into politics, if that's OK.
targetPatterns.translation: 没关系的话，我不想聊政治。

targetPatterns.pattern: That's a fair point, but have you considered...?
targetPatterns.example: That's a fair point, but have you considered...?
targetPatterns.translation: 有道理，但你有没有想过……
这篇文章引用了官方数据。

targetPatterns.pattern: Let's agree to disagree on this one.
targetPatterns.example: Let's agree to disagree on this one.
targetPatterns.translation: 这一点我们保留各自意见吧。

stages.title: Describe how the issue affects you
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Did you see the news about housing prices going up again?”
successCriteria: The learner can describe how the issue affects you in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Yes. My rent just …”

stages.title: Acknowledge another view and offer your own concern
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “I think building more homes is the main long-term answer.”
successCriteria: The learner can acknowledge another view and offer your own concern in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I see your point. …”

stages.title: Ask an open question that keeps the discussion constructive
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “That's a fair concern. I don't think there's a quick fix.”
successCriteria: The learner can ask an open question that keeps the discussion constructive in their own words.
hints: You can start with “What short-term changes do …”

modelDialogue.text: Did you see the news about housing prices going up again?
Yes. My rent just went up eight percent, so it's been on my mind.
I think building more homes is the main long-term answer.
I see your point. I'm also worried about what renters can afford right now.
That's a fair concern. I don't think there's a quick fix.
What short-term changes do you think might help?
